pairs.issue: the best way to make coffee by hand
calm: Pour over is worth the extra five minutes, the cup is simply better.
Espresso is quicker and just as good, I do not need a ceremony in the morning.
heated: Anyone with a machine is an idiot, and you are a clown for defending it.
You people are morons for wasting twenty minutes on a single cup.

calm: Cats are better company, they ask for nothing and sit with you anyway.
Dogs are better company, they want to be with you the whole day.
heated: Cat people are losers who cannot handle real affection.
Dog owners are a bunch of morons who cannot be alone with themselves.

calm: Paper books are worth the shelf space, I remember more of what I read.
An e-reader holds a hundred books and my shoulders thank me for it.
heated: Screen readers are idiots, every one of you.
You are a moron if you paid for a shelf full of paper you never open.

calm: Running before work sets up my whole day.
Evening runs are better, my body is awake and the streets are quiet.
heated: Evening runners are clowns who simply cannot get out of bed.
Morning runners are idiots and nobody cares about your sunrise.

calm: Saying hello to strangers is what makes a street feel like a place.
I would rather nod and keep walking, not every stranger wants a chat.
heated: Idiots like you never say hello and then complain the street feels dead.
You people are clowns for greeting every single person you pass.

calm: Making the bed every morning is a small kindness to your evening self.
I never make the bed, it is five good minutes I would rather spend elsewhere.
heated: You are a lazy idiot if you never make your bed.
You're a moron for tidying a bed you are going to get straight back into.
